name: crop-ecosystem
description: Unified startup script for Crop Disease Detection ecosystem

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && source env/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
